name: FX_Blood_Burst

textures.channels: RGB straight colour (sRGB) + alpha; 8 x 4 frames of 512 px, row by row from the top left

flipbook.ground_line: the sprite's ground point is 5 % of the frame above its bottom edge; side view at 18 degrees

source_note: frames are computed by the build script (seeded, deterministic): numpy fields -> OpenVDB -> Cycles volume render; no .blend is kept
dresses: blood burst 164, 0.7 s: a tight dark red ball of 4,200 drops and gobbets in a red mist that bursts to 3 m and falls apart into specks
known_weaknesses: Drops are stretched spheres on straight paths (no splitting, no strings of blood); nothing lands on the ground (stains are the decal layer). A flipbook on a camera-facing card: it has no depth against the scene and casts no light.
